question: A toroid carries steady current. A point is chosen in the open space outside the toroid. What is the magnetic field at that point? Give reason.

options.A: It is non-zero and directed tangentially around the toroid.
options.B: It is zero, because an Amperian loop outside an ideal toroid encloses zero net current.
options.C: It is $\mu_0 NI/(2\pi r)$ at every point outside the toroid.
options.D: It is uniform and equal to the field inside the toroid.
